[P2] Establish coverage for the deadline outcome policy

Rule 4, **Every branch has a test that fails without it**, is unmet here. The added evidence-normalization tests cover replay and normal return/failure; the recovery tests inspect only fixture observations. None exercises this deadline-specific `allowedStatuses` branch, so removing it leaves the supplied tests unchanged while changing acceptance for lifecycle cases 3 and 4. Return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) to justify this outcome contract and establish how its acceptance behavior will be verified.
